Class Tile

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.entities.tile.Tile
public class Tile extends Object
Represents a single tile on the game board or in the queue.

A tile may be occupied by at most one Player at a time. It carries two lists of effects: instant effects applied as soon as a player lands on it, and interactive effects that generate pending Action instances to be resolved by the player. The occupying player is stored both as an object reference (transient, excluded from JSON) and as a nickname string (persisted in JSON) so that the reference can be re-established after deserialization.

  • Constructor Details

    • Tile

      public Tile(int id, int minPlayers, List<CardEffectInstant> instantEffects, List<CardEffectInteractive> interactiveEffects, boolean occupied, String playerNickname)
      Constructs a Tile from its serialized JSON properties.
      Parameters:
      id - unique tile identifier
      minPlayers - minimum number of players for this tile to be active
      instantEffects - instant effects on this tile; null is treated as an empty list
      interactiveEffects - interactive effects on this tile; null is treated as an empty list
      occupied - whether the tile is currently occupied
      playerNickname - nickname of the occupying player, or null if unoccupied
